ida (eng-runtime): quick heads-up — vuln scan found allocator fixes we should pull into a rebuilt "base-min" image. planning a small, fast rebuild + cosign signing (no customer hits reported).

noor (eng-security): ok. two gating asks: 1) SBOM diff + commit SHAs in the attestation predicate, 2) audit retention for KMS/attestations = 13 months, 3) RBAC so only infra-builds SA + two approvers can promote.

ida (eng-runtime): artifacts built and staged: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/base-min/3990012345 (unsigned). pipeline ready but blocked on key + RBAC.

hugo (eng-infra): i can create a CMK alias/rebuild-3990-temp and attach kms:Sign + kms:GetPublicKey for the infra-builds role. ETA ~25m. i will also enable CloudTrail data events for the attest bucket.

noor (eng-security): add an IAM condition so Sign calls only come from our CI runner IPs or the EKS OIDC role. also require CloudTrail log validation on the S3 bucket. open an infra ticket for retention bump.

hugo (eng-infra): kubectl RBAC snippet to let the controller read attestations in `attest` ns:

```
kubectl create rolebinding rebuild-attest-reader -n attest --role=attest-reader --serviceaccount=infra:build-controller
```

and IAM (example):

```
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name infra-builds --policy-name RebuildCosignPolicy --policy-document '{\n  "Version":"2012-10-17",\n  "Statement":[{\n    "Effect":"Allow",\n    "Action":["kms:Sign","kms:GetPublicKey"],\n    "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/REBUILD_3990"\n  }]\n}'
```

noor (eng-security): good. CI must emit cosign attestations containing: sbom_hash, git_sha, changelog_url, ksm_key_arn, and signing_principal. also add a 2-approver manual gate before cosign runs.

ida (eng-runtime): CI snippet (high-level):

```
- run: cosign sign --key ksm://alias/rebuild-3990-temp registry.redwood/base-min:3990012345
- run: cosign attest --predicate sbom.json --key ksm://alias/rebuild-3990-temp registry.redwood/base-min:3990012345
- run: aws s3 cp sbom.json s3://redwood-attestations/base-min/3990012345/sbom.json
```

tara (oncall): rollout plan: staging-canary 5% -> 25% in 2h -> full in 24h if gates pass. thresholds: crashloop >0.5% sustained 5m or image pull errors spike -> pause and rollback. who triggers rollback?

ida (eng-runtime): i'll trigger rollback and revert router weights. tara will escalate to SRE/security if needed. we'll keep both old and new images signed for traceability.

sign-bot: artifact ready: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/base-min/3990012345 (unsigned). waiting on key + approvals.

hugo (eng-infra): key created: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/REBUILD_3990. applying IAM policy and rolebinding now. will post when CloudTrail export + retention ticket is opened.

noor (eng-security): i'll open the approval ticket and verify attestations once cosign runs. please keep updates only in this thread.
